'''Hestus''' was a [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] during the age of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. A [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]], Hestus worked as a [[Translator/Legends|translator]] during the war, and in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] was aboard the [[Sith dreadnaught]] ''[[Omen]]'' when it was knocked off course as it jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] and crash-landed on the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Hestus, along with his cousin [[Ravilan Wroth]], survived the disaster. Soon afterward, Hestus used his ability as a translator to facilitate a conversation between the ''Omen''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Yaru Korsin]], and a native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] woman named [[Adari Vaal]], as they exchanged information about the situation of the ''Omen''{{'s}} crew and life in Keshiri society.

With Vaal's help, the stranded Sith, including Hestus, made their way to Keshiri civilization and took their place as rulers of Kesh. Over the next fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Hestus combed through Keshiri oral histories in search of information that could help the Sith escape from Kesh, to no avail. In [[4985 BBY]], after Hestus' cousin Wroth [[Death/Legends|killed]] thousands of Keshiri in an effort to get the Sith leaders to withdraw from Keshiri society and focus on finding a way off-planet, Hestus and the other members of the Sith [[Species/Legends|species]] on Kesh were executed in a widespread [[Red Sith Purge|purge]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith species]], Hestus served the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] as a [[Translator/Legends|translator]] during the era of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], Hestus had received an [[Acid/Legends|acid]] scar across his face, disfiguring him and forcing him to cover his wound with a shining mask, and he had enough [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implants to be considered a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]]. In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], in the midst of said conflict, Hestus was aboard the<ref name="skyborn" /> [[Sith dreadnaught]]<ref name="crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref> ''[[Omen]]'' when it was knocked off course as it jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] due to a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Skirmish over Phaegon III|attack]].<ref name="precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref> The ''Omen'' crashed in a [[Takara Mountains|mountain range]] in the remote, uncharted [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. Hestus, along with his cousin [[Ravilan Wroth]] and a sizable group of ''Omen'' crewmembers, survived the crash, but with their [[Starship/Legends|ship]] destroyed, the survivors had no way to reach civilization. Their salvation soon came in the form of a native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] woman, [[Adari Vaal]]. Fleeing from trouble with the Keshiri establishment, Vaal stumbled across the makeshift Sith settlement in the mountains, and was taken in by the castaways.<ref name="skyborn" />

With the [[Keshiri language|language]] barrier a significant problem, Hestus was enlisted to aid with communications between the ''Omen''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Yaru Korsin]], and the frightened Vaal. Hestus, a talented translator, stunned Vaal with his incredible ability to quickly pick up and repeat the Keshiri language. Hestus helped to speed up the exchange of information between Korsin and Vaal, as the two spoke about the arrival of the Sith on Kesh and Keshiri society. After the discussion was over, Korsin sent Vaal to lead Keshiri authorities to the Sith in the mountains, hoping to facilitate their escape from their ramshackle settlement. Although Hestus and Wroth were both worried about that arrangement, neither Sith did anything to prevent Vaal's departure. Vaal did her part, and the Sith were able to make their way back to civilization, where they posed as Keshiri [[Skyborn|gods]] and took their place as rulers of Kesh. Hestus and the other so-called "[[Deity/Legends|gods]]" were quartered in the homes of the traditional Keshiri ruling council, the [[Neshtovar]], and the Sith translator quickly went to work indexing the Keshiri language.<ref name="skyborn" />

By [[4985 BBY]], the Sith had mostly given up hope of finding a way off Kesh, and had settled in as their own [[Lost Tribe of Sith|tribe]]. Undaunted, however, Hestus continued to work with other linguists from the ''Omen'' to search through Keshiri oral histories for anything about anyone who had ever happened by the planet, or would eventually return again and could provide the Sith escape. Despite his efforts, Hestus found little. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Hestus's cousin Ravilan Wroth engineered a plan to falsify a deadly virus, [[Death/Legends|killing]] thousands of Keshiri in an attempt to get the Sith leaders to focus on escaping Kesh. However, his plan was discovered, prompting Korsin and the other [[Human/Legends|Human]] Sith to [[Red Sith Purge|purge]] Kesh of the surviving members of the Sith species on the planet, including Hestus. Hestus was personally executed by Yaru Korsin's wife [[Seelah Korsin|Seelah]], and his body was put on display publicly in a plaza in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tahv]]. Yaru Korsin fully intended to remove Hestus's cybernetic implants, hoping to find some use for them.<ref name="paragon" />

==Personality and traits==
A cyborg, Hestus had a number of cybernetic implants, along with a shining mask that he wore over a large acid scar on his face. Although his appearance could frighten those who were unfamiliar with him, such reactions did not faze Hestus at all. Hestus had a special ability to pick up foreign languages quickly, and repeat them exactly. Hestus was distrustful of Adari Vaal, and was worried that she might betray the Sith if Yaru Korsin let her go.<ref name="skyborn" /> A tireless worker, Hestus toiled for years trying to find something in the Keshiri oral histories that could facilitate an escape from Kesh, although his efforts were unsuccessful.<ref name="paragon" /> As a member of the Sith species, Hestus had [[Color/Legends|red]] skin, specifically resembling the color of rust.<ref name="skyborn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hestus made his first appearance in [[John Jackson Miller]]'s [[2009]] [[eBook]] ''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Skyborn]]''.<ref name="skyborn" />
